name: infomaniak-mcp-server
description: MCP server for the Infomaniak public API (hosting, domains, kDrive, mail, AI Tools, order catalogue).

scripts.mcpb:pack: npm run build && rm -rf bundle && mkdir bundle && cp -r dist manifest.json package.json package-lock.json .env.example bundle/ && cd bundle && npm ci --omit=dev --silent && cd .. && npx --yes @anthropic-ai/mcpb@latest pack bundle infomaniak-mcp-server-$npm_package_version.mcpb
